name: com.xengine.voxelworld
description: Official optional voxel world runtime for XEngine: 16-cubed chunks, greedy meshing, biome terrain, and first-person build tools. Ships with the Editor but is not mounted until installed. Preview builds may include temporary third-party art listed in THIRD_PARTY_ASSETS.md; package code is MIT.

samples.description: Placeholder sample folder. Playable Flat/Earth scenes land in later nodes.
